1.en: June 2004 saw the first passage, known as a ‘transit’, of the planet Venus across the face of the Sun in 122 years.
parts: 2004年6月，金星从日面前经过，这是122年来首次出现这种称为“凌日”的现象。

2.en: Transits have helped shape our view of the whole Universe, as Heather Cooper and Nigel Henbest explain
parts: 正如希瑟·库珀和奈杰尔·亨贝斯特所解释的那样，凌日现象帮助我们形成了对整个宇宙的认识。

3.en: On 8 June 2004, more than half the population of the world were treated to a rare astronomical event.
parts: 2004年6月8日，世界上超过一半的人有幸目睹了一次罕见的天象。

4.en: For over six hours, the planet Venus steadily inched its way over the surface of the Sun.
parts: 在六个多小时里，金星一点一点地移过日面。

5.en: This ‘transit’ of Venus was the first since 6 December 1882.
parts: 这是自1882年12月6日以来首次出现金星凌日。

6.en: On that occasion, the American astronomer Professor Simon Newcomb led a party to South Africa to observe the event.
parts: 那一次，美国天文学家西蒙·纽康教授率领一队人前往南非观测这一天象。

7.en: They were based at a girls’ school, where - it is alleged - the combined forces of three schoolmistresses outperformed the professionals with the accuracy of their observations.
parts: 他们以一所女子学校为驻地，
据说，那里的三位女教师通力合作，观测结果比专业人士的还要准确。

8.en: For centuries, transits of Venus have drawn explorers and astronomers alike to the four corners of the globe.
parts: 几个世纪以来，金星凌日吸引着探险家和天文学家奔赴世界各地。
terms: the four corners of the globe
the four corners of the globe

9.en: And you can put it all down to the extraordinary polymath Edmond Halley.
parts: 而这一切都可归功于非凡的博学之士埃德蒙·哈雷。

10.en: In November 1677, Halley observed a transit of the innermost planet, Mercury, from the desolate island of St Helena in the South Pacific.
parts: 1677年11月，哈雷在南太平洋荒凉的圣赫勒拿岛上观测到了水星凌日。水星是离太阳最近的行星。

11.en: He realised that, from different latitudes, the passage of the planet across the Sun’s disc would appear to differ.
parts: 他意识到，从不同纬度观察，行星在日面上经过的路径看起来会有所不同。

12.en: By timing the transit from two widely-separated locations, teams of astronomers could calculate the parallax angle - the apparent difference in position of an astronomical body due to a difference in the observer’s position.
parts: 天文学家们可以在两个相距很远的地点分别为凌日计时，据此算出视差角，
也就是因观测者位置不同而造成的天体视位置之差。

13.en: Calculating this angle would allow astronomers to measure what was then the ultimate goal: the distance of the Earth from the Sun.
parts: 算出这个角度，天文学家就能测出他们当时最想知道的距离，也就是地球与太阳之间的距离。

14.en: This distance is known as the ‘astronomical unit’ or AU.
parts: 这个距离称为“天文单位”，简称AU。

15.en: Halley was aware that the AU was one of the most fundamental of all astronomical measurements.
parts: 哈雷知道，天文单位是所有天文测量值中最基本的指标之一。

16.en: Johannes Kepler, in the early 17th century, had shown that the distances of the planets from the Sun governed their orbital speeds, which were easily measurable.
parts: 早在17世纪初，约翰内斯·开普勒就已证明，行星与太阳之间的距离决定了它们的公转速度，而公转速度很容易测量。

17.en: But no-one had found a way to calculate accurate distances to the planets from the Earth.
parts: 但当时还没有人找到准确计算地球到各行星距离的方法。

18.en: The goal was to measure the AU; then, knowing the orbital speeds of all the other planets round the Sun, the scale of the Solar System would fall into place.
parts: 目标是测出一个天文单位有多长。
有了这个距离，再知道其他各行星绕太阳运行的速度，太阳系的尺度便可随之确定。

19.en: However, Halley realised that Mercury was so far away that its parallax angle would be very difficult to determine.
parts: 然而，哈雷意识到，水星距离地球很远，要测定它的视差角会非常困难。

20.en: As Venus was closer to the Earth, its parallax angle would be larger, and Halley worked out that by using Venus it would be possible to measure the Sun’s distance to 1 part in 500.
parts: 由于金星离地球更近，它的视差角会更大。
哈雷算出，借助金星来测量日地距离，精度有望达到五百分之一。

21.en: But there was a problem: transits of Venus, unlike those of Mercury, are rare, occurring in pairs roughly eight years apart every hundred or so years.
parts: 但有一个困难。与水星凌日不同，金星凌日很少发生，
大约每隔一百年才成对出现，同一对的两次凌日相隔约八年。

22.en: Nevertheless, he accurately predicted that Venus would cross the face of the Sun in both 1761 and 1769 - though he didn’t survive to see either.
parts: 尽管如此，他还是准确预言金星会在1761年和1769年两度掠过日面，只是他没能活到亲眼见证其中任何一次。

23.en: Inspired by Halley’s suggestion of a way to pin down the scale of the Solar System, teams of British and French astronomers set out on expeditions to places as diverse as India and Siberia.
parts: 哈雷提出了一种确定太阳系尺度的方法。受此启发，
英法两国的天文学家组队远行，前往印度、西伯利亚等迥然不同的地方考察。

24.en: But things weren’t helped by Britain and France being at war.
parts: 但英法两国当时正在交战，这使事情更不顺利。

25.en: The person who deserves most sympathy is the French astronomer Guillaume Le Gentil.
parts: 最值得同情的是法国天文学家纪尧姆·勒让蒂。

26.en: He was thwarted by the fact that the British were besieging his observation site at Pondicherry in India.
parts: 由于英军当时正在围困他位于印度本地治里的观测点，他的计划受了阻。

27.en: Fleeing on a French warship crossing the Indian Ocean, Le Gentil saw a wonderful transit - but the ship’s pitching and rolling ruled out any attempt at making accurate observations.
parts: 勒让蒂搭上一艘横渡印度洋的法国军舰撤离，在船上目睹了一次壮观的金星凌日。
但船身前后颠簸、左右摇晃，他根本无法进行准确观测。

28.en: Undaunted, he remained south of the equator, keeping himself busy by studying the islands of Mauritius and Madagascar before setting off to observe the next transit in the Philippines.
parts: 他没有气馁，继续留在赤道以南。
他先忙于考察毛里求斯岛和马达加斯加岛，随后动身前往菲律宾，准备观测下一次凌日。

29.en: Ironically after travelling nearly 50,000 kilometres, his view was clouded out at the last moment, a very dispiriting experience.
parts: 颇具讽刺意味的是，他奔波了近五万公里，最后关头却被云层挡住了视线，实在令人沮丧。

30.en: While the early transit timings were as precise as instruments would allow, the measurements were dogged by the ‘black drop’ effect.
parts: 早期的凌日计时已经达到了当时仪器所能达到的精度，测量结果却一直受到“黑滴效应”的干扰。

31.en: When Venus begins to cross the Sun’s disc, it looks smeared not circular - which makes it difficult to establish timings.
parts: 金星开始掠过日面时，看上去轮廓模糊，不呈圆形，因此很难准确判定时间。

32.en: This is due to diffraction of light.
parts: 这是光的衍射造成的。

33.en: The second problem is that Venus exhibits a halo of light when it is seen just outside the Sun’s disc.
parts: 第二个问题是，当人们看到金星刚好位于日面以外时，它的周围会出现一圈光晕。

34.en: While this showed astronomers that Venus was surrounded by a thick layer of gases refracting sunlight around it, both effects made it impossible to obtain accurate timings.
parts: 这固然让天文学家看出，金星周围包裹着一层厚厚的气体，这些气体使阳光在金星周围发生折射，
但这两种效应使人无法准确计时。

35.en: But astronomers laboured hard to analyse the results of these expeditions to observe Venus transits.
parts: 尽管如此，天文学家仍投入了大量精力，分析这些远征观测金星凌日所得的结果。

36.en: Johann Franz Encke, Director of the Berlin Observatory, finally determined a value for the AU based on all these parallax measurements: 153,340,000 km.
parts: 柏林天文台台长约翰·弗朗茨·恩克综合所有这些视差测量结果，终于算出一个天文单位的长度为153,340,000公里。

37.en: Reasonably accurate for the time, that is quite close to today’s value of 149,597,870 km, determined by radar, which has now superseded transits and all other methods in accuracy.
parts: 以当时的条件衡量，这个数值相当准确，与如今用雷达测得的149,597,870公里非常接近。
就精度而言，雷达测量如今已胜过凌日观测和其他所有方法。

38.en: The AU is a cosmic measuring rod, and the basis of how we scale the Universe today.
parts: 天文单位就像一把宇宙量尺，是我们今天衡量宇宙尺度的基础。

39.en: The parallax principle can be extended to measure the distances to the stars.
parts: 视差原理还可以推广，用于测量恒星与我们的距离。

40.en: If we look at a star in January - when Earth is at one point in its orbit - it will seem to be in a different position from where it appears six months later.
parts: 假设我们在一月观测一颗恒星，此时地球位于其公转轨道上的某一点，
那么这颗恒星看上去的位置会与六个月后看到的不同。

41.en: Knowing the width of Earth’s orbit, the parallax shift lets astronomers calculate the distance.
parts: 知道了地球轨道的宽度，天文学家就可以利用视差所造成的视位置偏移算出恒星的距离。

42.en: June 2004’s transit of Venus was thus more of an astronomical spectacle than a scientifically important event.
parts: 所以，2004年6月的金星凌日更像是一场天文奇观，其科学意义相对有限。

43.en: But such transits have paved the way for what might prove to be one of the most vital breakthroughs in the cosmos - detecting Earth-sized planets orbiting other stars.
parts: 不过，历次凌日观测为一项可能跻身宇宙探索最重大突破之列的发现铺平了道路，
那就是探测绕其他恒星运行、大小与地球相当的行星。

1.en: A millennium ago, stepwells were fundamental to life in the driest parts of India.
parts: 一千年前，在印度最干旱的地区，阶梯井对当地人的生活至关重要。

2.en: Richard Cox travelled to north-western India to document these spectacular monuments from a bygone era
parts: 理查德·考克斯前往印度西北部，记录这些昔日留下的壮观古迹。

3.en: During the sixth and seventh centuries, the inhabitants of the modern-day states of Gujarat and Rajasthan in north-western India developed a method of gaining access to clean, fresh groundwater during the dry season for drinking, bathing, watering animals and irrigation.
parts: 公元6至7世纪，今印度西北部古吉拉特邦和拉贾斯坦邦一带的居民想出了一种办法，可以在旱季取得清洁的地下淡水，
用来饮用、洗澡、给牲畜饮水和灌溉。

6.en: During their heyday, they were places of gathering, of leisure and relaxation and of worship for villagers of all but the lowest classes.
parts: 在阶梯井的鼎盛时期，这些井是除社会最底层以外各阶层村民聚会、休闲放松和礼拜的场所。

10.en: When the water level was high, the user needed only to descend a few steps to reach it; when it was low, several levels would have to be negotiated.
parts: 水位高时，用水的人只需下几级台阶就能取到水；
水位低时，则得向下走好几层。

37.en: Tourists flock to wells in far-flung corners of north-western India to gaze in wonder at these architectural marvels from hundreds of years ago, which serve as a reminder of both the ingenuity and artistry of ancient civilisations and of the value of water to human existence.
parts: 游客纷纷涌向印度西北部偏远地区的古井，惊叹于这些建于数百年前的建筑奇观。
它们既让人想起古代文明的创造力与艺术才华，也提醒人们水对人类生存的重要性。

5.en: Unique to this region, stepwells are often architecturally complex and vary widely in size and shape.
parts: 阶梯井为这一地区所特有，建筑结构往往很复杂，大小和形状也各不相同。

28.en: One of the larger examples is Raniji Ki Baori, which was built by the queen of the region, Nathavatji, in 1699.
parts: 较大的阶梯井中有一座叫拉尼吉阶梯井，由当地王后纳塔瓦特吉于1699年修建。

29.en: At 46 metres deep, 20 metres wide and 40 metres long, the intricately carved monument is one of 21 baoris commissioned in the Bundi area by Nathavatji.
parts: 这座古迹深46米、宽20米、长40米，雕刻精细，是纳塔瓦特吉在本迪一带委托修建的21座阶梯井之一。

30.en: In the old ruined town of Abhaneri, about 95 kilometres east of Jaipur, is Chand Baori, one of India’s oldest and deepest wells; aesthetically it’s perhaps one of the most dramatic.
parts: 斋浦尔以东约95公里处是阿巴内里古镇的遗址。昌德阶梯井坐落于此，是印度最古老、最深的井之一；
论外观，它或许也是最壮观的井之一。

31.en: Built in around 850 AD next to the temple of Harshat Mata, the baori comprises hundreds of zigzagging steps that run along three of its sides, steeply descending 11 storeys, resulting in a striking pattern when seen from afar.
parts: 这座阶梯井约建于公元850年，紧邻哈沙特·玛塔神庙。数百级台阶沿井的三面呈之字形排列，
陡然向下延伸十一层，从远处看，形成一幅引人注目的图案。

32.en: On the fourth side, verandas which are supported by ornate pillars overlook the steps.
parts: 在井的第四面，装饰华丽的柱子支撑着游廊，从廊上可以俯瞰台阶。

33.en: Still in public use is Neemrana Ki Baori located just off the Jaipur-Delhi highway.
parts: 尼姆拉纳阶梯井就在斋浦尔至德里的公路旁，至今仍供公众使用。

34.en: Constructed in around 1700, it is nine storeys deep, with the last two being underwater.
parts: 这口井约建于1700年，有九层深，最下面两层浸在水中。

35.en: At ground level, there are 86 colonnaded openings from where the visitor descends 170 steps to the deepest water source.
parts: 在地面这一层，有86个带柱廊的入口。游客从这里往下走170级台阶，就能到达最深处的水源。

36.en: Today, following years of neglect, many of these monuments to medieval engineering have been saved by the Archaeological Survey of India, which has recognised the importance of preserving them as part of the country’s rich history.
parts: 这些见证中世纪工程技艺的古迹曾长期无人照管。如今，印度考古局已抢救了其中许多座。
该局已认识到，这些古迹是印度丰富历史的一部分，保护它们十分重要。

14.en: A substantial proportion of the population of modern societies engages in such tourist practices new socialised forms of provision have developed in order to cope with the mass character of the gazes of tourists as opposed to the individual character of travel.
parts: 现代社会有相当一部分人参加这类旅游活动。
新的社会化服务形式已经出现，用以适应游客观光的大众性；与之相对，旅行具有个体性。

22.en: Historically, textile dyes were made from such natural sources as plants and animal excretions.
parts: 过去，人们用植物、动物排泄物等天然原料制作纺织染料。

23.en: Some of these, such as the glandular mucus of snails, were difficult to obtain and outrageously expensive.
parts: 有些原料很难取得，例如蜗牛腺体分泌的黏液，而且价格贵得惊人。

24.en: Indeed, the purple colour extracted from a snail was once so costly that in society at the time only the rich could afford it.
parts: 确实，从蜗牛中提取的紫色染料一度十分昂贵，当时社会上只有富人才买得起。

25.en: Further, natural dyes tended to be muddy in hue and fade quickly.
parts: 此外，天然染料的色调往往暗浊，而且褪色很快。

26.en: Sure enough, these amphibious species show up on the triangular graph approximately half way between the ‘wet cluster’ of sea turtles and the ‘dry cluster’ of land tortoises.
parts: 果然，这些水陆两栖物种在三角图上的位置，大致介于海龟的“水生点群”和陆龟的“陆生点群”正中间。

28.en: The bones of P. quenstedti and P. talampayensis leave us in no doubt.
parts: P. quenstedti 和 P. talampayensis 这两种龟的骨骼让我们确信无疑。

29.en: Their points on the graph are right in the thick of the dry cluster.
parts: 它们在图上的点正落在陆生点群的密集处。

32.en: You might think, therefore, that modern land tortoises have probably stayed on land ever since those early terrestrial times, as most mammals did after a few of them went back to the sea.
parts: 因此，你也许会认为，自那个早期陆生阶段以来，现代陆龟很可能一直生活在陆地上；
正如在少数哺乳动物重返海洋之后，大多数哺乳动物一直留在陆地上一样。

34.en: If you draw out the family tree of all modern turtles and tortoises, nearly all the branches are aquatic.
parts: 如果画出所有现代水龟和陆龟的系统树，就会发现几乎所有分支都是水生的。

36.en: This suggests that modern land tortoises have not stayed on land continuously since the time of P. quenstedti and P. talampayensis.
parts: 这表明，自 P. quenstedti 和 P. talampayensis 所生活的时代以来，现代陆龟并非一直生活在陆地上。

1.en: Undersea turbines which produce electricity from the tides are set to become an important source of renewable energy for Britain.
parts: 利用潮汐发电的海底涡轮机有望成为英国重要的可再生能源来源。

2.en: It is still too early to predict the extent of the impact they may have, but all the signs are that they will play a significant role in the future
parts: 现在预测这些涡轮机可能产生多大影响还为时过早，但种种迹象都表明，它们将在未来发挥重要作用。

3.en: Operating on the same principle as wind turbines, the power in sea turbines comes from tidal currents which turn blades similar to ships’ propellers, but, unlike wind, the tides are predictable and the power input is constant.
parts: 海底涡轮机与风力涡轮机的工作原理相同。它的动力来自潮流，流动的海水带动形似船舶螺旋桨的叶片旋转。
不过，潮汐与风不同，可以预测，而且输入功率稳定。

4.en: The technology raises the prospect of Britain becoming self-sufficient in renewable energy and drastically reducing its carbon dioxide emissions.
parts: 这项技术使英国有望实现可再生能源自给，并大幅减少二氧化碳排放。

5.en: If tide, wind and wave power are all developed, Britain would be able to close gas, coal and nuclear power plants and export renewable power to other parts of Europe.
parts: 如果潮汐能、风能和波浪能都得到开发，
英国就能关闭燃气、燃煤和核能发电厂，并向欧洲其他地区出口用可再生能源生产的电力。
terms: 用可再生能源生产的电力

6.en: Unlike wind power, which Britain originally developed and then abandoned for 20 years allowing the Dutch to make it a major industry, undersea turbines could become a big export earner to island nations such as Japan and New Zealand.
parts: 风能原本由英国开发，英国后来却将其搁置了二十年，荷兰人由此得以将风能发展为一大产业。
海底涡轮机则可能成为英国面向日本、新西兰等岛国的出口创汇大项。

7.en: Tidal sites have already been identified that will produce one sixth or more of the UK’s power - and at prices competitive with modern gas turbines and undercutting those of the already ailing nuclear industry.
parts: 已经确定了一些潮汐发电场址，这些场址将能提供英国六分之一或更多的电力。
其电价足以与现代燃气轮机发电的价格竞争，且低于本已不景气的核电行业的电价。

8.en: One site alone, the Pentland Firth, between Orkney and mainland Scotland, could produce 10% of the country’s electricity with banks of turbines under the sea, and another at Alderney in the Channel Islands three times the 1,200 megawatts of Britain’s largest and newest nuclear plant, Sizewell B, in Suffolk.
parts: 仅奥克尼群岛与苏格兰本土之间的彭特兰海峡这一处，成排的海底涡轮机就可提供全国10%的电力。
海峡群岛奥尔德尼岛的另一处场址，则可提供相当于萨福克郡塞兹韦尔B核电站三倍的发电功率。后者是英国最大、最新的核电站，功率为1200兆瓦。

12.en: AbuBakr Bahaj, in charge of the Southampton research, said: ‘The prospects for energy from tidal currents are far better than from wind because the flows of water are predictable and constant.
parts: 负责南安普敦这项研究的阿布巴克尔·巴哈吉说：“潮流发电的前景远胜风力发电，
因为水流既可预测又稳定。

13.en: The technology for dealing with the hostile saline environment under the sea has been developed in the North Sea oil industry and much is already known about turbine blade design, because of wind power and ship propellers.
parts: 北海石油工业已经开发出应对海底恶劣盐水环境的技术；
借助风力发电和船舶螺旋桨方面的经验，人们对涡轮叶片的设计也已有了相当多的了解。

17.en: The best sites are between islands or around heavily indented coasts where there are strong tidal currents.
parts: 最佳场址位于岛屿之间，或在海岸线曲折、潮流强劲的沿海地带。

20.en: Unlike wind power, there are unlikely to be environmental objections.
parts: 与风力发电不同，潮汐发电不太可能遭到环保方面的反对。

26.en: One technical difficulty is cavitation, where low pressure behind a turning blade causes air bubbles.
parts: 一个技术难题是空化：旋转叶片背后的压力较低，会形成气泡。

27.en: These can cause vibration and damage the blades of the turbines.
parts: 这些气泡可能引起振动，损坏涡轮机的叶片。

28.en: Dr Bahaj said: ‘We have to test a number of blade types to avoid this happening or at least make sure it does not damage the turbines or reduce performance.
parts: 巴哈吉博士说：“我们得试验多种类型的叶片，以免发生这种情况；
至少也要确保这种现象不会损坏涡轮机或降低其性能。

29.en: Another slight concern is submerged debris floating into the blades.
parts: 另一个小小的顾虑是，水下漂浮的杂物可能漂进叶片之间。

31.en: We will have to make the turbines robust because the sea is a hostile environment, but all the signs that we can do it are good.’
parts: 我们得把涡轮机造得足够坚固，因为海洋环境很恶劣。
不过，目前的种种迹象都表明，我们有望做到这一点。”

9.en: Other sites identified include the Bristol Channel and the west coast of Scotland, particularly the channel between Campbeltown and Northern Ireland.
parts: 其他已经确定的场址包括布里斯托尔海峡和苏格兰西海岸，尤其是坎贝尔敦与北爱尔兰之间的海峡。

10.en: Work on designs for the new turbine blades and sites are well advanced at the University of Southampton’s sustainable energy research group.
parts: 南安普敦大学可持续能源研究小组对新型涡轮叶片和场址的设计工作已取得很大进展。

11.en: The first station is expected to be installed off Lynmouth in Devon shortly to test the technology in a venture jointly funded by the department of Trade and Industry and the European Union.
parts: 首座电站预计不久就会安装在德文郡林茅斯近海，用以测试这项技术。
这一项目由英国贸易与工业部和欧盟共同出资。

14.en: There are a few technical difficulties, but I believe in the next five to ten years we will be installing commercial marine turbine farms.’
parts: 还有几个技术难题，但我相信，在未来五至十年内，我们就会着手建设商业海洋涡轮发电场。”

15.en: Southampton has been awarded £215,000 over three years to develop the turbines and is working with Marine Current Turbines, a subsidiary of IT power, on the Lynmouth project.
parts: 南安普敦大学获得了一笔为期三年、总额21.5万英镑的资助，用于研发涡轮机；
该校正与IT Power旗下的海流涡轮机公司合作，开发林茅斯项目。

16.en: EU research has now identified 106 potential sites for tidal power, 80% round the coasts of Britain.
parts: 欧盟的研究迄今已确定106个潜在的潮汐发电场址，其中80%位于英国沿海。

18.en: A marine turbine blade needs to be only one third of the size of a wind generator to produce three times as much power.
parts: 海洋涡轮机的叶片只需有风力发电机三分之一的大小，就能产生三倍的功率。

19.en: The blades will be about 20 metres in diameter, so around 30 metres of water is required.
parts: 叶片旋转时的直径约为20米，因此所需水深约为30米。

21.en: Fish and other creatures are thought unlikely to be at risk from the relatively slow-turning blades.
parts: 人们认为，这些转动相对缓慢的叶片不太可能危及鱼类和其他生物。

22.en: Each turbine will be mounted on a tower which will connect to the national power supply grid via underwater cables.
parts: 每台涡轮机都将安装在一座塔架上，塔架将经由水下电缆与国家电网相连。

23.en: The towers will stick out of the water and be lit, to warn shipping, and also be designed to be lifted out of the water for maintenance and to clean seaweed from the blades.
parts: 这些塔架将伸出水面，并点灯警示过往船只；
设计上还可将塔架提出水面，以便进行维护，清除叶片上的海藻。

24.en: Dr Bahaj has done most work on the Alderney site, where there are powerful currents.
parts: 巴哈吉博士研究得最多的是奥尔德尼岛的场址，那里的海流很强。

25.en: The single undersea turbine farm would produce far more power than needed for the Channel Islands and most would be fed into the French Grid and be re-imported into Britain via the cable under the Channel.
parts: 单是这一处海底涡轮发电场，发电量就会远超海峡群岛所需；
其中大部分电力将输入法国电网，然后经英吉利海峡底部的电缆重新输入英国。

30.en: So far we do not know how much of a problem it might be.
parts: 目前我们还不知道这可能会带来多大的问题。

1.en: The fact that people go to the Louvre museum in Paris to see the original painting Mona Lisa when they can see a reproduction anywhere leads us to question some assumptions about the role of museums of fine art in today’s world
parts: 人们在任何地方都能看到《蒙娜丽莎》的复制品，却仍然前往巴黎卢浮宫观看原作。
这一事实促使我们重新审视有关美术馆在当今世界所起作用的一些既有看法。

3.en: Nearly everyone who goes to see the original will already be familiar with it from reproductions, but they accept that fine art is more rewardingly viewed in its original form.
parts: 前去看原画的人几乎都已通过复制品熟悉了这幅画，
但他们认同，欣赏美术作品的原作更有收获。

4.en: However, if Mona Lisa was a famous novel, few people would bother to go to a museum to read the writer’s actual manuscript rather than a printed reproduction.
parts: 然而，假如《蒙娜丽莎》是一部著名小说，很少有人会特意跑去博物馆读作家的手稿，而放着印刷本不读。

7.en: With novels, the reader attends mainly to the meaning of words rather than the way they are printed on the page, whereas the ‘reader’ of a painting must attend just as closely to the material form of marks and shapes in the picture as to any ideas they may signify.
parts: 读小说时，读者主要关注的是词语的含义，而非它们印在书页上的样子；
“读”画的人则必须同样仔细地关注两方面：一是画中笔触和形状的具体形态，二是它们可能表达的意思。

8.en: Yet it has always been possible to make very accurate facsimiles of pretty well any fine art work.
parts: 不过，几乎任何美术作品历来都可以仿制得十分逼真。

9.en: The seven surviving versions of Mona Lisa bear witness to the fact that in the 16th century, artists seemed perfectly content to assign the reproduction of their creations to their workshop apprentices as regular ‘bread and butter’ work.
parts: 现存的七个《蒙娜丽莎》版本证明，
在16世纪，画家们似乎很乐意把复制自己作品的活儿交给工作室的学徒，当作他们日常谋生的工作。

10.en: And today the task of reproducing pictures is incomparably more simple and reliable, with reprographic techniques that allow the production of high-quality prints made exactly to the original scale, with faithful colour values, and even with duplication of the surface relief of the painting.
parts: 如今，复制画作的工作简单、可靠得多。图像复制技术可以制作高质量的印刷品，尺寸与原作完全相同，
色彩明暗忠实于原作，甚至连画面表层的凹凸纹理都能复现。

20.en: Evidently, nothing the viewer thinks about the work is going to alter that value, and so today’s viewer is deterred from trying to extend that spontaneous, immediate, self-reliant kind of reading which would originally have met the work.
parts: 显然，观者对作品的任何看法都改变不了这个价值。
因此，如今的观者很难再尝试像作品问世之初的人那样，把自发、直接、凭自身判断的解读继续深入下去。

5.en: For Robert B. Cialdini, Professor of Psychology at Arizona State University, one reason that companies don’t succeed as often as they should is that Innovation starts with recruitment.
parts: 在亚利桑那州立大学心理学教授罗伯特·B. 西奥迪尼看来，企业成功的次数没有应有的那么多，其中一个原因是创新始于招聘。

6.en: Research shows that the fit between an employee’s values and a company’s values makes a difference to what contribution they make and whether, two years after they join, they’re still at the company.
parts: 研究表明，员工个人价值观与公司价值观的契合程度，会影响员工能作出怎样的贡献，
也会影响他们入职两年后是否仍在这家公司工作。

3.en: In April 2002 an event took place which demonstrated one of the many applications of information theory.
parts: 2002年4月发生的一件事，展示了信息论众多用途中的一种。

5.en: Megafires, also called ‘siege fires’, are the increasingly frequent blazes that burn 500,000 acres or more - 10 times the size of the average forest fire of 20 years ago.
parts: 特大野火也叫“围困式大火”。这种火灾越来越频繁，每场烧过的面积达50万英亩或更多，
是20年前一场森林火灾平均过火面积的十倍。

10.en: ‘All these factors must have been necessary but not sufficient to cause the revolution,’ says Macfarlane.
parts: 麦克法兰说：“这些因素一定都是促成这场革命的必要条件，但还不是充分条件。”

6.en: Macfarlane compares the puzzle to a combination lock.
parts: 麦克法兰把这个谜题比作一把密码锁。

7.en: ‘There are about 20 different factors and all of them need to be present before the revolution can happen,’ he says.
parts: 他说：“大约有二十个不同的因素，必须全部具备，这场革命才有可能发生。”

8.en: For industry to take off, there needs to be the technology and power to drive factories, large urban populations to provide cheap labour, easy transport to move goods around, an affluent middle-class willing to buy mass-produced objects, a market-driven economy and a political system that allows this to happen.
parts: 工业要腾飞，需要能让工厂运转的技术和动力，能提供廉价劳动力的庞大城市人口，
便于运输货物的交通，愿意购买大批量生产的商品的富裕中产阶级，
还需要市场驱动的经济和容许这一切发生的政治体制。

16.en: The theory sounds eccentric but once he starts to explain the detective work that went into his deduction, the scepticism gives way to wary admiration.
parts: 这个理论听起来有些古怪，但他一开始解释自己是怎样像侦探一样调查、得出这个结论的，怀疑便逐渐变成了带有几分保留的钦佩。

36.en: ‘When you start moving towards an industrial revolution, it is economically efficient to have people living close together,’ says Macfarlane.
parts: 麦克法兰说：“社会开始迈向工业革命时，人们集中居住在经济上更有效率。”

55.en: Macfarlane notes that even though 17th-century Japan had large cities, high literacy rates, even a futures market, it had turned its back on the essence of any work-based revolution by giving up labour-saving devices such as animals, afraid that they would put people out of work.
parts: 麦克法兰指出，尽管十七世纪的日本有大城市、很高的识字率，甚至还有期货市场，
它却背离了任何生产变革的要义。日本放弃了畜力等节省劳力的手段，担心这些手段会让人失业。

1.en: Internationally, ‘giftedness’ is most frequently determined by a score on a general intelligence test, known as an IQ test, which is above a chosen cut-off point, usually at around the top 2-5%.
parts: 在世界各地，最常见的“天赋”判定方法，是看一个人在一般智力测验（即智商测验）中的得分是否超过选定的分界值。
这条分界线通常划在得分最高的约2%至5%的人群处。

2.en: Children’s educational environment contributes to the IQ score and the way intelligence is used.
parts: 儿童的教育环境会影响他们的智商得分，也会影响他们运用智力的方式。

4.en: The higher the children’s IQ scores, especially over IQ 130, the better the quality of their educational backup, measured in terms of reported verbal interactions with parents, number of books and activities in their home etc.
parts: 孩子的智商得分越高，尤其是超过130时，他们得到的教育支持质量也越高。
衡量这种支持的指标包括据报孩子与父母的言语交流、家里的藏书和活动数量等。

5.en: Because IQ tests are decidedly influenced by what the child has learned, they are to some extent measures of current achievement based on age-norms; that is, how well the children have learned to manipulate their knowledge and know-how within the terms of the test.
parts: 由于智商测验显然受到孩子所学内容的影响，这类测验在一定程度上衡量的是孩子相对于其年龄常模的当前学习成果。
也就是说，它衡量孩子学会在测验规定的范围内运用知识和技能的程度。

9.en: To reach an exceptionally high standard in any area very able children need the means to learn, which includes material to work with and focused challenging tuition - and the encouragement to follow their dream.
parts: 要在任何一个领域达到格外高的水准，能力出众的孩子都需要相应的学习条件。
这些条件包括可供使用的材料、有针对性且富有挑战性的指导，以及鼓励他们追求梦想的支持。

10.en: There appears to be a qualitative difference in the way the intellectually highly able think, compared with more average-ability or older pupils, for whom external regulation by the teacher often compensates for lack of internal regulation.
parts: 与能力较为普通或年龄较大的学生相比，智力出众的学生在思维方式上似乎有质的差异。
对于那些能力较为普通或年龄较大的学生，教师的外部调节往往能弥补他们自我调节的不足。

11.en: To be at their most effective in their self-regulation, all children can be helped to identify their own ways of learning - metacognition - which will include strategies of planning, monitoring, evaluation, and choice of what to learn.
parts: 为了让所有孩子都能最有效地调节自己的学习，可以帮助他们辨认自己的学习方式，即培养元认知。
其中包括制订计划、监控、评估以及选择学习内容的策略。

12.en: Emotional awareness is also part of metacognition, so children should be helped to be aware of their feelings around the area to be learned, feelings of curiosity or confidence, for example.
parts: 觉察自己的情绪也是元认知的一部分，因此应帮助孩子留意自己对所学领域的感受，例如好奇或自信。

15.en: Overviewing research on the thinking process of highly able children, (Shore and Kanevsky, 1993) put the instructor’s problem succinctly: ‘If they [the gifted] merely think more quickly, then we need only teach more quickly.
parts: 肖尔和卡内夫斯基（1993年）在综述能力出众的儿童如何思考的研究时，简明地指出了教师面临的问题。
“如果他们〔指天赋儿童〕只是思考得更快，那么我们只需教得更快。

24.en: Given that a fundamental goal of education is to transfer the control of learning from teachers to pupils, improving pupils’ learning to learn techniques should be a major outcome of the school experience, especially for the highly competent.
parts: 教育的一项根本目标，是把学习的主导权从教师手中交给学生。
有鉴于此，提高学生“学会学习”的能力，理应是学校教育的一项重要成果，对能力很强的学生尤其如此。

25.en: There are quite a number of new methods which can help, such as child-initiated learning, ability-peer tutoring, etc.
parts: 有不少新方法可以提供帮助，例如由孩子主动发起的学习、能力相近的同伴间的辅导等。
terms: 由孩子主动发起的学习
能力相近的同伴间的辅导

26.en: Such practices have been found to be particularly useful for bright children from deprived areas.
parts: 研究发现，这些做法对来自贫困地区的聪颖儿童特别有用。

27.en: But scientific progress is not all theoretical, knowledge is also vital to outstanding performance: individuals who know a great deal about a specific domain will achieve at a higher level than those who do not (Elshout, 1995).
parts: 但科学进步并非全是理论性的，知识对于取得出色的表现也至关重要。
对某个特定领域了解甚深的人，其成就水平会高于缺乏这方面知识的人（埃尔斯豪特，1995年）。

28.en: Research with creative scientists by Simonton (1988) brought him to the conclusion that above a certain high level, characteristics such as independence seemed to contribute more to reaching the highest levels of expertise than intellectual skills, due to the great demands of effort and time needed for learning and practice.
parts: 西蒙顿（1988年）对富有创造力的科学家进行了研究，并得出如下结论。
在达到某个较高水平之后，要取得最高水平的专业造诣，独立性等特质似乎比智力技能作用更大，
因为学习和练习都需要投入大量精力和时间。
terms: 在达到某个较高水平之后

6.en: The vocabulary aspect, for example, is dependent on having heard those words.
parts: 例如，测验中词汇这一项的表现，就取决于孩子以前是否听过那些词。

2.en: This search, often known by the acronym SETI (search for extra-terrestrial intelligence), is a difficult one.
parts: 这项搜寻工作很艰难，通常简称SETI，即“搜寻地外智慧生命”。

8.en: In this sense, SETI is another cog in the machinery of pure science which is continually pushing out the horizon of our knowledge.
parts: 从这个意义上说，搜寻地外智慧生命也是纯科学这部机器中的一个齿轮，而纯科学正在不断拓展我们的知识边界。

15.en: It is even possible that the older civilisation may pass on the benefits of their experience in dealing with threats to survival such as nuclear war and global pollution, and other threats that we haven’t yet discovered.
parts: 那种更古老的文明甚至可能把经验传给我们，使我们也能从中获益。
这些经验涉及应对生存威胁，如核战争、全球污染，以及我们尚未发现的其他威胁。

16.en: In discussing whether we are alone, most SETI scientists adopt two ground rules.
parts: 在讨论人类是否是宇宙中唯一的智慧生命时，多数从事地外智慧生命搜寻的科学家遵循两条基本规则。

18.en: Second, we make a very conservative assumption that we are looking for a life form that is pretty well like us, since if it differs radically from us we may well not recognise it as a life form, quite apart from whether we are able to communicate with it.
parts: 其次，我们作了一个十分保守的假设：我们寻找的是与我们大体相似的生命形式。
因为如果它与我们截然不同，我们很可能连它是生命都认不出来，更不用说能否与之交流了。

25.en: Descriptive grammarians have been presented as people who do not care about standards, because of the way they see all forms of usage as equally valid.
parts: 描写派语法学家把各种语言用法都视为同样合理。正因为如此，他们被描绘成不在乎语言规范的人。

26.en: Prescriptive grammarians have been presented as blind adherents to a historical tradition.
parts: 规定派语法学家则被描绘成盲目追随某一历史传统的人。

27.en: The opposition has even been presented in quasi-political terms - of radical liberalism vs elitist conservatism.
parts: 人们甚至用近乎政治化的措辞来描述这种对立，将其说成激进自由主义与精英保守主义的对抗。

18.en: If insects paid attention to such advertisements, they might be prompted to lay their eggs on a duller, and presumably less resistant host.
parts: 如果昆虫留意到这样的信号，它们就可能转而在颜色较暗淡、抗虫能力想必也较弱的寄主植物上产卵。

21.en: In response, the researchers issued a review of all the ganzfeld studies done up to 1985 to show that 80 per cent had found statistically significant evidence.
parts: 作为回应，研究人员发表了一篇综述，梳理截至1985年开展的所有甘兹费尔德实验，
旨在说明其中80%的研究发现了具有统计显著性的证据。

10.en: The perception of smell, therefore, consists not only of the sensation of the odours themselves, but of the experiences and emotions associated with them.
parts: 因此，对气味的感知不仅包括对气味本身的感觉，也包括与这些气味相联系的经历和情感。

18.en: Once the glass cooled to 604°C or less it was too hard to mark and could be transported out of the cooling zone by rollers.
parts: 玻璃一旦冷却至604摄氏度或以下，就已硬到不会留下压痕，可以用辊轮将它送出冷却区。

13.en: Inherently introverted, he realised early on that as an academic, his reticence would prove disastrous in the lecture hall.
parts: 他生性内向，很早就意识到，身为学者，自己的寡言少语在讲堂上会带来灾难性的后果。

25.en: Tanya Streeter’s passion is freediving - the sport of plunging deep into the water without tanks or other breathing equipment.
parts: 塔尼娅·斯特里特酷爱自由潜水，即在不使用气瓶或其他呼吸设备的情况下潜入深水的运动。

6.en: What they’re discovering is that many of these qualities amount to habitual behaviour that determines the way we respond to the world.
parts: 他们发现，这些特质中有许多实质上是习惯性行为，而这些行为决定了我们如何回应周围的世界。

4.en: However, researchers have begun looking more closely at ways we can change.
parts: 不过，研究人员已开始更仔细地探究，人可以怎样改变自己。

18.en: On campus, he quickly found that beyond ordinary counselling, the university had no services for students who were undergoing physical rehabilitation and suffering from depression like him.
parts: 到校后，他很快发现，除了一般性的心理咨询，
大学并没有为像他这样一边接受身体康复治疗、一边饱受抑郁之苦的学生提供其他服务。

24.en: You can recognise a person who is passionate about a pursuit by the way they are so strongly involved in it.
parts: 一个人是否对所从事的事充满热情，从其投入之深就能看出来。

26.en: Beginning in 1998, she set nine world records and can hold her breath for six minutes.
parts: 从1998年起，她创下了九项世界纪录。她能屏住呼吸长达六分钟。

31.en: The secret about consuming passions, though, according to psychologist Paul Silvia of the University of North Carolina, is that ‘they require discipline, hard work and ability, which is why they are so rewarding.’
parts: 不过，北卡罗来纳大学的心理学家保罗·西尔维亚指出，让人全情投入的爱好有一个奥秘，
那就是“它们需要自律、苦功和能力，而这也正是它们如此令人有成就感的原因”。

36.en: He finally took a break and during eight months in Santa Fe, Zappaterra learned about alternative healing techniques not taught at Harvard.
parts: 他终于停下来歇了一阵。在圣达菲的八个月里，扎帕泰拉了解了哈佛没有教授的替代疗法。

43.en: For marketing executive Kenneth Pedeleose, it meant speaking out against something he thought was ethically wrong.
parts: 对营销主管肯尼斯·佩德洛斯来说，这意味着公开反对他认为有违道德的事。

44.en: The new manager was intimidating staff so Pedeleose carefully recorded each instance of bullying and eventually took the evidence to a senior director, knowing his own job security would be threatened.
parts: 新任经理恐吓员工，佩德洛斯便仔细记下每一次欺凌事件。
他最终把证据交给了一位高管，尽管他清楚这样会危及自己的饭碗。

45.en: Eventually the manager was the one to go.
parts: 最终，离开的是那位经理。

46.en: According to Cynthia Pury, a psychologist at Clemson University, Pedeleose’s story proves the point that courage is not motivated by fearlessness, but by moral obligation.
parts: 克莱姆森大学的心理学家辛西娅·普里认为，佩德洛斯的经历印证了这一点，
人之所以有勇气，靠的是道德责任感，并非无所畏惧。

48.en: Many of her students said that faced with a risky situation, they first tried to calm themselves down, then looked for a way to mitigate the danger, just as Pedeleose did by documenting his allegations.
parts: 她的许多学生说，面对有风险的处境时，他们先设法让自己冷静下来，
再寻找降低风险的办法，就像佩德洛斯把自己指控的事情记录下来那样。

50.en: And in the short term, the effort itself could be surprisingly rewarding, a kind of internal adventure.
parts: 而就短期而言，这番努力本身就可能给人带来意想不到的收获，像是一次内心的探险。

34.en: In 2004, physician-scientist Mauro Zappaterra began his PhD research at Harvard Medical School.
parts: 2004年，兼任医生和科研人员的毛罗·扎帕泰拉开始在哈佛医学院从事博士研究。

21.en: At the same time greater efforts must be made to achieve a modal shift.
parts: 与此同时，还必须作出更大努力，推动运输方式的转变。

22.en: Such a change cannot be achieved overnight, all the less so after over half a century of constant deterioration in favour of road.
parts: 这种转变不可能一蹴而就，何况半个多世纪以来，运输格局愈发失衡，公路运输越来越占优势。

23.en: This has reached such a pitch that today rail freight services are facing marginalisation, with just 8% of market share, and with international goods trains struggling along at an average speed of 18km/h.
parts: 这种失衡已严重到如下地步：如今铁路货运正面临边缘化，市场份额仅为8%，
而国际货运列车行进缓慢，平均时速只有18公里。

2.en: Throughout the course of history, people have travelled for purposes of trade, religious conviction, economic gain, war, migration and other equally compelling motivations.
parts: 纵观历史，贸易、宗教信仰、经济利益、战争、迁徙，以及其他同样强有力的动机，都曾促使人们出行。

4.en: Seaside resorts located at Pompeii and Herculaneum afforded citizens the opportunity to escape to their vacation villas in order to avoid the summer heat of Rome.
parts: 庞贝和赫库兰尼姆的海滨度假地，让市民有机会暂时离开罗马，前往自己的度假别墅，
以避开罗马夏日的酷热。

17.en: This industry is the world’s leading industrial contributor, producing over 6 per cent of the world’s gross national product and accounting for capital investment in excess of $422 billion in direct, indirect and personal taxes each year.
parts: 这一行业是全球贡献最大的产业，其产值超过全球国民生产总值的6%；
在直接税、间接税和个人税方面，该行业每年所涉及的资本投资超过4220亿美元。

20.en: The travel industry includes: hotels, motels and other types of accommodation; restaurants and other food services; transportation services and facilities; amusements, attractions and other leisure facilities; gift shops and a large number of other enterprises.
parts: 旅游业包括旅馆、汽车旅馆及其他类型的住宿设施，餐馆及其他餐饮服务，
交通运输服务与设施，各种娱乐活动、游览景点及其他休闲设施，
以及礼品店和大量其他企业。

24.en: However, the nature of this very diversity makes travel and tourism ideal vehicles for economic development in a wide variety of countries, regions or communities.
parts: 然而，恰恰是这种多样性，使旅游活动和旅游业成为众多国家、地区或社区发展经济的理想途径。

26.en: In fact, McIntosh and Goeldner (1990) suggest that tourism has become the largest commodity in international trade for many nations and, for a significant number of other countries, it ranks second or third.
parts: 事实上，麦金托什和戈尔德纳（1990年）认为，在许多国家，旅游已成为国际贸易中最大的一项商品；
而在数量相当可观的其他国家，旅游则排在第二或第三位。

28.en: In addition, Hawkins and Ritchie, quoting from data published by the American Express Company, suggest that the travel and tourism industry is the number one ranked employer in the Bahamas, Brazil, Canada, France, (the former) West Germany, Hong Kong, Italy, Jamaica, Japan, Singapore, the United Kingdom and the United States.
parts: 此外，霍金斯和里奇援引美国运通公司公布的数据指出，
在巴哈马、巴西、加拿大、法国、原西德、香港、意大利、牙买加、日本、新加坡、英国和美国，旅游业是雇用人数最多的行业。

29.en: However, because of problems of definition, which directly affect statistical measurement, it is not possible with any degree of certainty to provide precise, valid or reliable data about the extent of world-wide tourism participation or its economic impact.
parts: 然而，定义上的问题直接影响统计计量。
因此，无论是全球参与旅游的规模，还是旅游的经济影响，都无法有把握地提供精确、有效或可靠的数据。

10.en: In turn, international tourism became the concern of a number of world governments since it not only provided new employment opportunities but also produced a means of earning foreign exchange.
parts: 相应地，国际旅游也受到世界上多个国家政府的关注，因为它既提供了新的就业机会，也带来了赚取外汇的途径。

22.en: In addition, Meis (1992) points out that the tourism industry involves concepts that have remained amorphous to both analysts and decision makers.
parts: 此外，迈斯（1992年）指出，旅游业涉及的一些概念，对分析人士和决策者来说一直都缺乏清晰的界定。

1.en: Travel has existed since the beginning of time, when primitive man set out, often traversing great distances in search of game, which provided the food and clothing necessary for his survival.
parts: 旅行自古就有。早期人类为寻找猎物而出行，常常跋涉很远，
这些猎物为他们提供了生存所必需的食物和衣物。

7.en: Historians suggest that the advent of mass tourism began in England during the industrial revolution with the rise of the middle class and the availability of relatively inexpensive transportation.
parts: 历史学家认为，大众旅游最早兴起于工业革命时期的英格兰，
当时中产阶级开始崛起，人们也有了相对便宜的交通方式。

14.en: According to the World Travel and Tourism Council (1992), ‘Travel and tourism is the largest industry in the world on virtually any economic measure including value-added capital investment, employment and tax contributions’.
parts: 据世界旅游及旅行理事会（1992年）称，“按几乎任何经济指标来衡量，旅游业都是全球最大的产业，
这些指标包括增值资本投资、就业和税收贡献。”

23.en: Moreover, in all nations this problem has made it difficult for the industry to develop any type of reliable or credible tourism information base in order to estimate the contribution it makes to regional, national and global economies.
parts: 此外，在各个国家，这个问题都使旅游业难以建立任何可靠或可信的旅游信息库，
用以估算旅游业对地区、国家和全球经济的贡献。

15.en: In 1992, the industry’s gross output was estimated to be $3.5 trillion, over 12 per cent of all consumer spending.
parts: 据估算，1992年该行业的总产出为3.5万亿美元，这一数额超过了全部消费支出的12%。

8.en: In the mythology of giftedness, it is popularly believed that if people are talented in one area, they must be defective in another, that intellectuals are impractical, that prodigies burn too brightly too soon and burn out, that gifted people are eccentric, that they are physical weaklings, that there’s a thin line between genius and madness, that genius runs in families, that the gifted are so clever they don’t need special help, that giftedness is the same as having a high IQ, that some races are more intelligent or musical or mathematical than others, that genius goes unrecognised and unrewarded, that adversity makes men wise or that people with gifts have a responsibility to use them.
parts: 围绕天赋流传着种种迷思。人们普遍相信，一个人若在某一方面有天赋，在另一方面就一定有缺陷，知识分子也都不切实际。
还有说法认为，神童过早大放异彩，才华也会早早耗尽。有天赋的人性情古怪、身体孱弱，
天才与疯狂只有一线之隔，天才会在家族中代代相传，有天赋的人聪明到无需特别帮助。
还有一种看法把天赋等同于高智商，认为某些族群比其他族群更聪明，或更有音乐、数学天赋。
类似的说法还有，天才得不到赏识和回报，逆境使人明智，或者有天赋的人有责任运用自己的天赋。

3.en: With her husband, Pierre Curie, and Henri Becquerel, she was awarded the 1903 Nobel Prize for Physics, and was then sole winner of the 1911 Nobel Prize for Chemistry.
parts: 她与丈夫皮埃尔·居里、亨利·贝克勒尔共同获得了1903年的诺贝尔物理学奖，
随后又独自获得了1911年的诺贝尔化学奖。
names: 玛丽亚·斯克沃多夫斯卡

6.en: Because her father lost his savings through bad investment, she then had to take work as a teacher.
parts: 父亲因投资失利损失了积蓄，于是她不得不当老师。

7.en: From her earnings she was able to finance her sister Bronia’s medical studies in Paris, on the understanding that Bronia would, in turn, later help her to get an education.
parts: 她靠自己的收入资助姐姐布罗尼娅在巴黎学医，
两人约定，日后布罗尼娅也会反过来帮助她接受教育。

8.en: In 1891 this promise was fulfilled and Marie went to Paris and began to study at the Sorbonne (the University of Paris).
parts: 1891年，这一承诺兑现了。玛丽前往巴黎，开始在索邦大学（巴黎大学）学习。

9.en: She often worked far into the night and lived on little more than bread and butter and tea.
parts: 她经常工作到深夜，平日几乎只靠面包、黄油和茶过活。

11.en: It was not until the spring of that year that she was introduced to Pierre Curie.
parts: 直到那年春天，她才经人介绍认识了皮埃尔·居里。

13.en: Following Henri Becquerel’s discovery in 1896 of a new phenomenon, which Marie later called ‘radioactivity’, Marie Curie decided to find out if the radioactivity discovered in uranium was to be found in other elements.
parts: 1896年亨利·贝克勒尔发现了一种新现象，玛丽后来将其称为“放射性”。
在此之后，玛丽·居里决定弄清楚，铀中发现的放射性是否也存在于其他元素中。

15.en: Turning her attention to minerals, she found her interest drawn to pitchblende, a mineral whose radioactivity, superior to that of pure uranium, could be explained only by the presence in the ore of small quantities of an unknown substance of very high activity.
parts: 她转而关注矿物，对沥青铀矿产生了兴趣。
这种矿物的放射性强于纯铀，唯一的解释是矿石中含有少量放射性极强的未知物质。

17.en: While Pierre Curie devoted himself chiefly to the physical study of the new radiations, Marie Curie struggled to obtain pure radium in the metallic state.
parts: 皮埃尔·居里主要致力于从物理学角度研究这些新发现的辐射，而玛丽·居里则费力地尝试获得金属态的纯镭。

18.en: This was achieved with the help of the chemist Andre-Louis Debierne, one of Pierre Curie’s pupils.
parts: 她在化学家安德烈-路易·德比埃尔纳的帮助下做到了这一点。他是皮埃尔·居里的学生之一。
names: 安德烈-路易·德比埃尔纳

23.en: The sudden death of her husband in 1906 was a bitter blow to Marie Curie, but was also a turning point in her career: henceforth she was to devote all her energy to completing alone the scientific work that they had undertaken.
parts: 丈夫在1906年猝然离世，给玛丽·居里以沉重打击，也成了她职业生涯的转折点。
从此，她将全部精力投入两人先前共同开展的科学工作，独自将其完成。

26.en: During World War I, Marie Curie, with the help of her daughter Irene, devoted herself to the development of the use of X-radiography, including the mobile units which came to be known as ‘Little Curies’, used for the treatment of wounded soldiers.
parts: 第一次世界大战期间，玛丽·居里在女儿伊雷娜的帮助下，致力于拓展X射线摄影的应用。
其中包括后来被称为“小居里”的移动式设备，这些设备用于救治伤兵。

27.en: In 1918 the Radium Institute, whose staff Irene had joined, began to operate in earnest, and became a centre for nuclear physics and chemistry.
parts: 伊雷娜已成为镭研究所的一员。1918年，研究所开始全面运作，后来成为核物理学和化学的研究中心。

29.en: In 1921, accompanied by her two daughters, Marie Curie made a triumphant journey to the United States to raise funds for research on radium.
parts: 1921年，玛丽·居里在两个女儿的陪同下前往美国，为镭的研究筹款。这次访问大获成功。

30.en: Women there presented her with a gram of radium for her campaign.
parts: 当地妇女赠给她一克镭，支持她的筹款活动。

31.en: Marie also gave lectures in Belgium, Brazil, Spain and Czechoslovakia and, in addition, had the satisfaction of seeing the development of the Curie Foundation in Paris, and the inauguration in 1932 in Warsaw of the Radium Institute, where her sister Bronia became director.
parts: 玛丽还曾在比利时、巴西、西班牙和捷克斯洛伐克讲学。
此外，令她欣慰的是，她看到巴黎居里基金会发展起来，
也见证了华沙镭研究所于1932年正式成立。她的姐姐布罗尼娅在那里担任所长。

32.en: One of Marie Curie’s outstanding achievements was to have understood the need to accumulate intense radioactive sources, not only to treat illness but also to maintain an abundant supply for research.
parts: 玛丽·居里的杰出成就之一，是认识到储备强放射源的必要性。
这些放射源既可用于治疗疾病，也能为研究提供充足的供应。

33.en: The existence in Paris at the Radium Institute of a stock of 1.5 grams of radium made a decisive contribution to the success of the experiments undertaken in the years around 1930.
parts: 巴黎镭研究所存有1.5克镭。这一储备对1930年前后所进行的实验取得成功起了决定性作用。

34.en: This work prepared the way for the discovery of the neutron by Sir James Chadwick and, above all, for the discovery in 1934 by Irene and Frederic Joliot-Curie of artificial radioactivity.
parts: 这项工作为詹姆斯·查德威克爵士发现中子铺平了道路，
尤其为伊雷娜和弗雷德里克·约里奥-居里于1934年发现人工放射性铺平了道路。
names: 弗雷德里克·约里奥-居里

35.en: A few months after this discovery, Marie Curie died as a result of leukaemia caused by exposure to radiation.
parts: 这项发现之后数月，玛丽·居里因接触辐射所致的白血病去世。

36.en: She had often carried test tubes containing radioactive isotopes in her pocket, remarking on the pretty blue-green light they gave off.
parts: 她常把装有放射性同位素的试管放在口袋里，还曾谈起它们发出的漂亮蓝绿色光芒。

37.en: Her contribution to physics had been immense, not only in her own work, the importance of which had been demonstrated by her two Nobel Prizes, but because of her influence on subsequent generations of nuclear physicists and chemists.
parts: 她对物理学的贡献极大。这既体现在她自己的研究上，两次获诺贝尔奖足以说明这些研究的重要性，
也体现在她对后世核物理学家和化学家的影响上。

7.en: In the time when the dinosaurs dominated the daytime economy, our mammalian ancestors probably only managed to survive at all because they found ways of scraping a living at night.
parts: 在恐龙主宰白天的生存空间时，我们的哺乳动物祖先之所以能够勉强活下来，
很可能全靠它们找到了在夜间勉强维生的办法。
terms: 白天争夺生存资源的活动

6.en: Food production has kept pace with soaring populations mainly because of the expansion of artificial irrigation systems that make possible the growth of 40 % of the world’s food.
parts: 粮食生产一直赶得上人口的急速增长，主要得益于人工灌溉系统的扩展。
正是这些系统使全球40%的粮食得以种植。

5.en: Virtually all pupils at this stage attend state schools: only 3 per cent are in the private sector.
parts: 这一阶段的学生几乎全都就读于公立学校，只有3%在私立学校就读。

15.en: Individual insects are placed in plastic or glass tubes (1.5-3.0 ml capacity for small ants, 5-8 ml for larger ants) containing 75% to 95% ethanol.
parts: 昆虫被逐只放入盛有浓度为75%到95%的乙醇的塑料管或玻璃管中（小型蚂蚁用容量为1.5至3.0毫升的管，较大的蚂蚁用5至8毫升的管）。

7.en: The word has ugly connotations thanks largely to Cesare Lombroso, a 19th-century Italian medic who argued that criminals were born not made and could be identified by certain physical features that were throwbacks to a primitive, sub-human state.
parts: 这个词之所以带有令人反感的意味，很大程度上是19世纪意大利医生切萨雷·龙勃罗梭造成的。
他主张，罪犯生来如此，而且可以凭某些身体特征把他们辨认出来。
在他看来，这些特征表明人退回到了原始的、尚未完全进化为人的状态。

9.en: In 1890 he proposed that evolution was irreversible: that ‘an organism is unable to return, even partially, to a previous stage already realised in the ranks of its ancestors’.
parts: 1890年，他提出进化不可逆，即“一个生物体无法回到其祖先曾经达到的演化阶段，哪怕只是部分地回到那个阶段也不行”。

10.en: Early 20th-century biologists came to a similar conclusion, though they qualified it in terms of probability, stating that there is no reason why evolution cannot run backwards—it is just very unlikely.
parts: 20世纪初的生物学家得出了类似的结论，但他们从概率的角度对这一结论加了限定。
他们指出，没有理由认为进化不能逆转，只是这种情况发生的可能性极小。

14.en: In 1919, for example, a humpback whale with a pair of leg-like appendages over a metre long, complete with a full set of limb bones, was caught off Vancouver Island in Canada.
parts: 例如，1919年在加拿大温哥华岛近海捕获了一头座头鲸。它长着一对一米多长、形似腿的附肢，里面的肢骨一应俱全。

25.en: The team calculated that there is a good chance of silent genes surviving for up to 6 million years in at least a few individuals in a population, and that some might survive as long as 10 million years.
parts: 研究团队算出，一个种群中至少有少数个体所携带的沉默基因，很有可能保留长达600万年，
有些基因甚至可能保留长达1000万年。

28.en: Like most amphibians these begin life in a juvenile ‘tadpole’ state, then metamorphose into the adult form—except for one species, the axolotl, which famously lives its entire life as a juvenile.
parts: 与大多数两栖动物一样，它们最初呈“蝌蚪”般的幼体形态，随后变态发育为成体。
只有墨西哥钝口螈这种动物例外，它以终生保持幼体形态而闻名。

30.en: From a detailed analysis of the salamanders’ family tree, however, it is clear that the other lineages evolved from an ancestor that itself had lost the ability to metamorphose.
parts: 然而，对这些蝾螈的系统树作详细分析便可清楚看到，其他谱系是从一个祖先进化而来的，而这个祖先本身已经失去了变态发育的能力。

34.en: In a paper published last year, biologist Gunter Wagner of Yale University reported some work on the evolutionary history of a group of South American lizards called Bachia.
parts: 在去年发表的一篇论文中，耶鲁大学的生物学家君特·瓦格纳报道了一项研究，
探讨的是一群名为Bachia的南美蜥蜴的演化史。

38.en: According to his analysis of the Bachia family tree, the toed species re-evolved toes from toeless ancestors and, what is more, digit loss and gain has occurred on more than one occasion over tens of millions of years.
parts: 根据他对Bachia系统树的分析，有趾的物种是从无趾的祖先重新演化出趾的。
更重要的是，在数千万年间，趾的丧失与重新获得发生过不止一次。

40.en: One possibility is that these traits are lost and then simply reappear, in much the same way that similar structures can independently arise in unrelated species, such as the dorsal fins of sharks and killer whales.
parts: 一种可能是，这些特征消失后又重新出现，
过程与并无近缘关系的物种各自演化出相似结构非常类似，例如鲨鱼和虎鲸都会长出背鳍。

41.en: Another more intriguing possibility is that the genetic information needed to make toes somehow survived for tens or perhaps hundreds of millions of years in the lizards and was reactivated.
parts: 另一种更耐人寻味的可能是，这些蜥蜴形成趾所需的遗传信息以某种方式保留了数千万年，甚至可能有数亿年之久，后来又被重新激活。

2.en: We tend to think of climate - as opposed to weather - as something unchanging, yet humanity has been at the mercy of climate change for its entire existence, with at least eight glacial episodes in the past 730,000 years.
parts: 我们往往把气候看作某种恒定的东西，并将它与天气区别开来。
然而，自人类出现以来，人类就一直受气候变化支配。在过去73万年间，就至少经历了八次冰期。

48.en: A laser thunder factory could shake the moisture out of clouds, perhaps preventing the formation of the giant hailstones that threaten crops.
parts: 用激光制造雷电的装置有可能震落云中的水分，或许还能阻止威胁农作物的巨大冰雹形成。

22.en: According to Mrs Kaiser Jamil of RRL, ‘The Argentinian weevil does not attack any other plant and a pair of adult bugs could destroy the weed in 4-5 days.’
parts: 地区研究实验室的凯泽尔·贾米尔女士说，“这种阿根廷象鼻虫不会危害其他任何植物，一对象鼻虫成虫可能在四五天内就能毁掉这种杂草。”

23.en: CIBC is also perfecting the technique for breeding parasites that prey on ‘disapene scale’ insects - notorious defoliants of fruit trees in the US and India.
parts: 英联邦生物防治研究所也在改进一种技术，用于繁育捕食盾蚧的寄生性天敌。盾蚧是美国和印度出了名的果树害虫，能使果树落叶。

30.en: In technical terms, these conjectures have their basis in the statistical likelihood of one interpretation over another and are heavily influenced by past experience and, importantly for potential iconoclasts, what other people say.
parts: 从技术上说，这些推测的依据是，从统计角度看，某一种解释比另一种更有可能成立。
过去的经验会对这些推测产生很大影响。别人的话同样有很大影响，这一点对可能打破常规的人尤其重要。

46.en: Neuroscience has revealed which brain circuits are responsible for functions like understanding what other people think, empathy, fairness, and social identity.
parts: 神经科学已经揭示，理解他人的想法、共情、公平感和社会认同等功能分别由哪些脑回路负责。

8.en: It was only after the creation of the FAA that full-scale regulation of America’s airspace took place, and this was fortuitous, for the advent of the jet engine suddenly resulted in a large number of very fast planes, reducing pilots’ margin of error and practically demanding some set of rules to keep everyone well separated and operating safely in the air.
parts: 直到美国联邦航空管理局成立之后，美国才开始对本国空域实施全面管制。这个时机恰好合适，
因为喷气发动机的问世一下子带来了大批飞行速度极快的飞机，
使飞行员出错的余地变小，几乎非得订出一套规则，让各架飞机保持足够的间隔，在空中安全飞行。

11.en: The FAA realised that the airspace over the United States would at any time have many different kinds of planes, flying for many different purposes, in a variety of weather conditions, and the same kind of structure was needed to accommodate all of them.
parts: 美国联邦航空管理局意识到，在任何时候，美国上空都会有多种飞机，
它们的飞行目的各不相同，遇到的天气条件也各不相同，
因此需要一套统一的空域管理体系，兼顾所有这些情况。

18.en: In this way, the recreational pilot who simply wishes to go flying for a while without all the restrictions imposed by the FAA has only to stay in uncontrolled airspace, below 365m, while the pilot who does want the protection afforded by ATC can easily enter the controlled airspace.
parts: 这样，休闲飞行员如果只想飞上一会儿，不想受联邦航空管理局种种限制的约束，只需留在365米以下的非管制空域。
而希望得到空中交通管制保护的飞行员，则可很方便地进入管制空域。

22.en: On a clear day, a pilot in controlled airspace can choose a VFR or IFR flight plan, and the FAA regulations were devised in a way which accommodates both VFR and IFR operations in the same airspace.
parts: 在晴朗的日子里，管制空域内的飞行员可以选择按目视飞行规则或仪表飞行规则制订飞行计划。
联邦航空管理局在制定规章时作了相应安排，使这两类飞行能够在同一空域内进行。

28.en: Generally, Class E airspace is where one finds general aviation aircraft (few of which can climb above 5,490m anyway), and commercial turboprop aircraft.
parts: 一般来说，在E类空域飞行的是通用航空飞机（反正其中很少有能爬升到5490米以上的），以及商用涡轮螺旋桨飞机。

25.en: Uncontrolled airspace is designated Class F, while controlled airspace below 5,490m above sea level and not in the vicinity of an airport is Class E.
parts: 非管制空域定为F类，而海拔低于5,490米且不在机场附近的管制空域则属E类。

26.en: All airspace above 5,490m is designated Class A.
parts: 海拔高于5,490米的空域一律划为A类。

27.en: The reason for the division of Class E and Class A airspace stems from the type of planes operating in them.
parts: 将空域分为E类和A类，原因在于两类空域中飞行的飞机类型不同。

1.en: An accident that occurred in the skies over the Grand Canyon in 1956 resulted in the establishment of the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to regulate and oversee the operation of aircraft in the skies over the United States, which were becoming quite congested.
parts: 1956年，大峡谷上空发生的一起事故促成了美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）的成立。
该机构负责规范和监督航空器在美国上空的运行，当时这片空域正变得相当拥挤。

4.en: As early as the 1920s, the earliest air traffic controllers manually guided aircraft in the vicinity of the airports, using lights and flags, while beacons and flashing lights were placed along cross-country routes to establish the earliest airways.
parts: 早在20世纪20年代，第一批空中交通管制员就用灯光和旗帜，以人工方式引导机场附近的飞机。
与此同时，人们沿国内长途飞行路线设置信标和闪光灯，建起了最早的空中航路。
terms: 横跨国内的长途飞行路线

10.en: AIS scientists work across a number of sports, applying skills learned in one - such as building muscle strength in golfers - to others, such as swimming and squash.
parts: 澳大利亚体育学院的科学家跨多个运动项目开展研究，把在某一项目中学到的技巧——例如增强高尔夫球手肌肉力量的方法——应用到其他项目中，例如游泳和壁球。

10.en: Clearly, Japanese carpenters of the day knew a few tricks about allowing a building to sway and settle itself rather than fight nature’s forces.
parts: 显然，当时的日本木匠掌握了一些窍门，能让建筑物随之摇摆、再自行恢复稳定，避免与自然力硬抗。

18.en: The ancient Gothic word for ten, tachund, is used to express the number 100 as tachund tachund.
parts: 古哥特语中表示“十”的词是 tachund，表示“一百”时就把这个词连用两次，写成 tachund tachund。
terms: 古哥特语中表示“一百”的说法

19.en: By the seventh century, the word teon had become interchangeable with the tachund or hund of the Anglo-Saxon language, and so 100 was denoted as hund teontig, or ten times ten.
parts: 到了七世纪，teon 已可与盎格鲁-撒克逊语中的 tachund 或 hund 互换使用，
因此一百便写作 hund teontig，意思是十乘以十。

42.en: In America the period of huge productivity gains in transportation may be almost over, but in most countries the process still has far to go.
parts: 在美国，运输业生产率大幅提高的时期也许已接近尾声，但在大多数国家，这一进程还有很长的路要走。

32.en: We hail as masterpieces the cave paintings in southern France and elsewhere, dating back some 20,000 years.
parts: 法国南部和其他地方的洞穴壁画距今约两万年，我们将它们奉为杰作。

7.en: And when did this event, or events, take place?
parts: 这次迁徙，或是这几次迁徙，发生在什么时候？

8.en: In recent years, new clues have come from research into genetics, including the distribution of genetic markers in modern Native Americans.
parts: 近年来，遗传学研究提供了新的线索，其中包括对当代美洲原住民遗传标记分布情况的研究。

9.en: An important project, led by the biological anthropologist Robert Williams, focused on the variants (called Gm allotypes) of one particular protein – immunoglobin G – found in the fluid portion of human blood.
parts: 生物人类学家罗伯特·威廉斯主持了一项重要研究，重点考察一种特定蛋白质的变体（称为 Gm 同种异型）。
这种蛋白质是免疫球蛋白G，存在于人体血液的液体成分中。

19.en: How far does other research support these conclusions?
parts: 其他研究在多大程度上支持这些结论？

20.en: Geneticist Douglas Wallace has studied mitochondrial DNA in blood samples from three widely separated Native American groups: Pima-Papago Indians in Arizona, Maya Indians on the Yucatán peninsula, Mexico, and Ticuna Indians in the Upper Amazon region of Brazil.
parts: 遗传学家道格拉斯·华莱士研究了三个相距很远的美洲原住民群体血样中的线粒体DNA。
这三个群体是亚利桑那州的皮马-帕帕戈人、墨西哥尤卡坦半岛的玛雅人和巴西亚马孙河上游地区的提库纳人。
大家都认为，从“生物学”的角度看，这一点显而易见。

4.en: However, in this statement we think of artificially produced, technical objects, products which are subjected to natural wear and tear during use.
parts: 然而，说这话时我们想到的是人工制造的技术产品，它们在使用过程中会自然磨损。

22.en: Every organism has a life span which is highly characteristic.
parts: 每种生物都有其特有的寿命。

28.en: Like the life span, the metabolic rate has for different organisms a fixed mathematical relationship to the body mass.
parts: 与寿命一样，不同生物的代谢率与其体重之间也存在固定的数学关系。

29.en: In comparison to the life span this relationship is ‘inverted’: the larger the organism the lower its metabolic rate.
parts: 与寿命和体重的关系相比，代谢率与体重的关系恰好“相反”：生物体越大，代谢率就越低。

32.en: In the Yukon and Kuskokwim rivers, chinook and chum runs were probably the poorest since statehood; subsistence communities throughout the region, who normally have priority over commercial fishing, were devastated.
parts: 在育空河和库斯科奎姆河，帝王鲑和狗鲑的洄游数量很可能是阿拉斯加建州以来最少的。
整个地区依靠捕鱼维生的社区都遭受了沉重打击，而这些社区捕鱼通常享有优先于商业捕捞的权利。
terms: 依靠当地资源维生的社区

1.en: More than two hundred years ago, Russian explorers and fur hunters landed on the Aleutian Islands, a volcanic archipelago in the North Pacific, and learned of a land mass that lay farther to the north.
parts: 两百多年前，俄国探险家和毛皮猎人登上了阿留申群岛，那是北太平洋的一组火山岛。
他们还得知更北边有一片陆地。

5.en: The rivers feed into the Bering Sea and Gulf of Alaska - cold, nutrient-rich waters which support tens of millions of seabirds, and over 400 species of fish, shellfish, crustaceans, and molluscs.
parts: 这些河流注入白令海和阿拉斯加湾。那里寒冷而富含养分的水域，
养育着数千万只海鸟，以及四百多种鱼类、贝类、甲壳类和软体动物。

7.en: According to the Alaska Department of Fish and Game (ADF&G), Alaska’s commercial fisheries landed hundreds of thousands of tonnes of shellfish and herring, and well over a million tonnes of groundfish (cod, sole, perch and pollock) in 2000.
parts: 据阿拉斯加州渔猎局（ADF&G）统计，2000年阿拉斯加商业渔业捕获上岸的贝类和鲱鱼达数十万吨，
底层鱼类（鳕鱼、鳎鱼、鲈鱼和狭鳕）的捕获量则远超一百万吨。

9.en: ‘Salmon,’ notes writer Susan Ewing in The Great Alaska Nature Factbook, ‘pump through Alaska like blood through a heart, bringing rhythmic, circulating nourishment to land, animals and people.’
parts: 作家苏珊·尤因在《阿拉斯加自然知识大全》中写道：“鲑鱼游遍阿拉斯加，犹如血液流经心脏，
给这片土地、这里的动物和人带来循环往复、富有节律的滋养。”

10.en: The ‘predictable abundance of salmon allowed some native cultures to flourish,’ and ‘dying spawners feed bears, eagles, other animals, and ultimately the soil itself.’
parts: 鲑鱼“总会如期大量出现，使一些原住民文化得以繁荣”，而“产卵后濒死的鲑鱼滋养着熊、鹰和其他动物，最终还滋养了土壤本身”。

11.en: All five species of Pacific salmon - chinook, or king; chum, or dog; coho, or silver; sockeye, or red; and pink, or humpback - spawn in Alaskan waters, and 90% of all Pacific salmon commercially caught in North America are produced there.
parts: 五种太平洋鲑鱼，包括帝王鲑（又称王鲑）、大麻哈鱼（又称狗鲑）、银鲑、红鲑和粉红鲑（又称驼背鲑），都在阿拉斯加水域产卵。
北美商业捕捞的太平洋鲑鱼中，有90%产自那里。

9.en: But on any given day, what Schaefer can offer is typical for today’s drugs rep - a car trunk full of promotional gifts and gadgets, a budget that could buy lunches and dinners for a small country, hundreds of free drug samples and the freedom to give a physician $200 to prescribe her new product to the next six patients who fit the drug’s profile.
parts: 不过，舍费尔平日能拿出的东西，在如今的医药代表中很常见：一后备厢的促销礼品和小玩意儿，
一笔足够请一个小国的人吃午饭和晚饭的预算，数百份免费药品样品，
她还有权给医生200美元，请对方给接下来六位符合用药条件的患者开她推销的新药。
terms: 在任何一个寻常的日子里
符合这种药的用药条件

10.en: And she also has a few $1,000 honoraria to offer in exchange for doctors’ attendance at her company’s next educational lecture.
parts: 此外，她还能提供几份酬金，每份1,000美元，请医生出席她公司下一场教育讲座。

3.en: A few months ago Kim Schaefer, sales representative of a major global pharmaceutical company, walked into a medical center in New York to bring information and free samples of her company’s latest products.
parts: 几个月前，一家大型跨国制药公司的销售代表金·舍费尔走进纽约的一家医疗中心，
向那里的人介绍公司的最新产品，并送去免费样品。

12.en: Salespeople like Schaefer walk the line between the common practice of buying a prospect’s time with a free meal, and bribing doctors to prescribe their drugs.
parts: 像舍费尔这样的销售人员，游走在两种做法的界线之间：一种是常见的做法，请潜在客户吃一顿饭，以换取对方的时间，
另一种则是贿赂医生，让他们开自己推销的药。
terms: 游走在两者的界线之间

30.en: In less enlightened countries, and in the European Union, the trend has been to reduce rather than eliminate subsidies and to introduce new payments to encourage farmers to treat their land in environmentally friendlier ways, or to leave it fallow.
parts: 在一些观念较为保守的国家以及欧盟，政策趋向于削减补贴，而非彻底取消，
并增设补助，鼓励农民以更环保的方式利用土地，或让土地休耕。

4.en: There had, of course, been dictionaries in the past, the first of these being a little book of some 120 pages, compiled by a certain Robert Cawdray, published in 1604 under the title A Table Alphabeticall ‘of hard usuall English wordes’.
parts: 当然，早先就有词典。其中最早的一部是一本约120页的小书，
由一位名叫罗伯特·考德里的人编成，于1604年出版，题名《字母顺序表》，收录的是“常用英语难词”。

2.en: Specifically, Milgram told each volunteer ‘teacher-subject’ that the experiment was in the noble cause of education, and was designed to test whether or not punishing pupils for their mistakes would have a positive effect on the pupils’ ability to learn.
parts: 具体来说，米尔格拉姆告诉每个以“教师”身份参加实验的志愿者，这项实验是为了教育这一崇高事业，
目的是检验因学生犯错而惩罚他们，是否会对他们的学习能力产生积极影响。
terms: 扮演教师的实验参与者

2.en: This is not just because of the importance of English-speaking countries such as the USA in scientific research; the scientists of many non-English-speaking countries find that they need to write their research papers in English to reach a wide international audience.
parts: 这不仅是因为美国等英语国家在科学研究中占有重要地位。
许多非英语国家的科学家发现，要让世界各地更多人读到自己的研究，他们就得用英语撰写论文。
terms: English-speaking countries such as the USA
English-speaking countries such as the USA

19.en: But caloric-restriction projects underway in two species more closely related to humans - rhesus and squirrel monkeys - have made scientists optimistic that CR mimetics could help people.
parts: 不过，目前正对两种与人类亲缘关系较近的猴开展热量限制研究，分别是恒河猴和松鼠猴。
这些研究使科学家乐观地认为，模拟热量限制作用的物质可能对人有益。
terms: 模拟热量限制作用的物质

2.en: As one writer observes: ‘Although it is now evident that artefacts are as easily altered as chronicles, public faith in their veracity endures: a tangible relic seems ipso facto real.’
parts: 正如一位作者所说：“如今人们已经清楚，文物和编年史一样容易被改动，
但公众依然相信文物真实无伪。遗物是有形的，单凭这一点，人们就觉得它是真的。”

12.en: On so-called heritage sites the re-enactment of historical events is increasingly popular, and computers will soon provide virtual reality experiences, which will present visitors with a vivid image of the period of their choice, in which they themselves can act as if part of the historical environment.
parts: 在所谓的历史遗址，历史事件重演越来越受欢迎。计算机也将很快提供虚拟现实体验，
让游客生动地看到自己选择的历史时期，仿佛置身当时的环境，亲自参与其中。

14.en: In a related development, the sharp distinction between museum and heritage sites on the one hand, and theme parks on the other, is gradually evaporating.
parts: 与此相关的另一个变化是，博物馆和历史遗址与主题公园之间原本鲜明的界线，正在逐渐消失。

16.en: For example, museums have adopted story lines for exhibitions, sites have accepted ‘theming’ as a relevant tool, and theme parks are moving towards more authenticity and research-based presentations.
parts: 例如，博物馆开始用故事线索串联展览，历史遗址也认可围绕主题来组织展示的做法，
而主题公园则越来越重视真实性，并以研究为依据来安排展示。

17.en: In zoos, animals are no longer kept in cages, but in great spaces, either in the open air or in enormous greenhouses, such as the jungle and desert environments in Burgers’ Zoo in Holland.
parts: 在动物园里，动物已不再关在笼中，而是养在宽阔的空间里，有的在露天，有的在巨大的温室里。
荷兰伯格斯动物园内的丛林和沙漠环境便是例子。

28.en: There is one compensation, however, for the professionals who make these interpretations: if they did not provide the interpretation, visitors would do it for themselves, based on their own ideas, misconceptions and prejudices.
parts: 不过，对于作出这些解读的专业人员来说，有一点可以聊以自慰。
如果他们不提供解读，游客也会根据自己的想法、误解和偏见自行解释。

4.en: Museums used to look - and some still do - much like storage rooms of objects packed together in showcases: good for scholars who wanted to study the subtle differences in design, but not for the ordinary visitor, to whom it all looked alike.
parts: 过去的博物馆很像储藏室，各种物件挤在陈列柜里，有些博物馆至今还是这样。
这种布置适合想研究设计细微差别的学者，却不适合普通参观者。在他们看来，这些东西都差不多。

23.en: Those who are professionally engaged in the art of interpreting history are thus in a difficult position, as they must steer a narrow course between the demands of ‘evidence’ and ‘attractiveness’ especially given the increasing need in the heritage industry for income-generating activities.
parts: 因此，专门从事历史解读的人处境艰难。
他们必须在“证据”和“吸引力”两方面的要求之间谨慎权衡，尤其是考虑到文化遗产行业越来越需要能够创收的活动。

34.en: In a town like Leyden in Holland, which in the seventeenth century was occupied by approximately the same number of inhabitants as today, people lived within the walled town, an area more than five times smaller than modern Leyden.
parts: 以荷兰莱顿为例，十七世纪时的居民人数与今天大致相同，
但当时人们住在城墙以内，那片区域的面积还不到现代莱顿的五分之一。
terms: more than five times smaller than
more than five times smaller than

30.en: However, according to an article in the Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society, the damage it did was estimated at US$4 billion but the benefits amounted to some US$19 billion.
parts: 不过，据《美国气象学会通报》的一篇文章估算，这次厄尔尼诺造成的损失为40亿美元，带来的收益却约有190亿美元。

1.en: Educating Psyche by Bernie Neville is a book which looks at radical new approaches to learning, describing the effects of emotion, imagination and the unconscious on learning.
parts: 伯尼·内维尔在《心智教育》一书中探讨了突破常规的学习方法，
并阐述了情感、想象力和无意识对学习的影响。

2.en: One theory discussed in the book is that proposed by George Lozanov, which focuses on the power of suggestion.
parts: 书中讨论的理论之一由乔治·洛扎诺夫提出，着重探讨暗示的力量。

6.en: If we think of a lecture we listened to with great concentration, we will recall the lecturer’s appearance and mannerisms, our place in the auditorium, the failure of the air-conditioning, much more easily than the ideas we went to learn.
parts: 回想一场我们曾全神贯注听过的讲座，讲者的外貌和习惯动作、我们在听众席上的座位，以及空调出了故障这些事，
都比我们原本想从中学到的观点更容易回忆起来。

7.en: Even if these peripheral details are a bit elusive, they come back readily in hypnosis or when we relive the event imaginatively, as in psychodrama.
parts: 即使这些无关主旨的细节有些难以回想，在催眠状态下，或在想象中重温当时的情景时（如在心理剧中），它们也很容易重新浮现。

10.en: Lozanov therefore made indirect instruction (suggestion) central to his teaching system.
parts: 因此，洛扎诺夫把间接教学（即暗示）置于其教学体系的核心。

41.en: While suggestopedia has gained some notoriety through success in the teaching of modern languages, few teachers are able to emulate the spectacular results of Lozanov and his associates.
parts: 暗示教学法虽然因在现代语言教学中取得成功而颇受瞩目，但很少有教师能取得洛扎诺夫及其同事那样引人注目的成效。
terms: 努力达到与……相同的水平

8.en: The details of the content of the lecture, on the other hand, seem to have gone forever.
parts: 相比之下，讲座内容的细节却仿佛再也想不起来了。
